ValidationRule.description: SS-2211 - If Customer Journey Account Task Type equals “Onboard” and Sub-Type equals “Document business objectives,” then do not allow the Customer Journey Account Task to be completed unless Business Objectives are found for the Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISNEW() = False && (ISCHANGED(Status__c) && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed")) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Journey' && ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Onboard") && ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Document business objectives") && Account_Business_Objective_Created__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot complete this Customer Journey Account Task until you create Business Objectives for your Account. Please create the Business Objectives and then come back to complete this Account Task.
